### Travelers Introduces AI-Powered Quoting Tool for Workers Compensation


October 28, 2026


*Travis Upload & Go* ℠ *eliminates manual data entry for small business agents*


HARTFORD, Conn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:[TRV](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=TRV&index=1&md5=a8e461536680960c615b9a2592efa400) ) today announced the launch of Travis Upload & Go℠, an AI-powered quoting tool that streamlines the workers compensation submission process for independent insurance agents serving small businesses.


**How *Travis Upload & Go* Works** *Travis Upload & Go* removes manual data entry from the workers compensation quoting process, allowing agents to spend less time on paperwork and more time with their customers. Through *Travis Upload & Go* , insurance agents upload documents, such as ACORD applications, standard industry forms and handwritten notes, to initiate a quote. The new tool then:


- Extracts information from the uploaded documents.
- Prefills account and policy fields.
- Runs eligibility checks automatically.
- Generates a bindable workers compensation quote in half the time.


**What the Data Shows** In an August 2026 Travelers survey of more than 150 small business insurance agents, 77% agreed that manual data entry is one of the most time-consuming and least valuable parts of their job. Fifty-four percent reported spending at least a quarter of their workday on it.


“We know speed matters when agents are quoting,” said Erin Rodliff, President of Small Commercial at Travelers. “ *Travis Upload & Go* removes cumbersome data entry from their workflow so they can reinvest that time in the customer relationships that grow their business.”


**Accessing *Travis Upload & Go*** *Travis Upload & Go* is accessible to independent agents within Travis®, Travelers’ rate, quote and issue platform for small business insurance policies. For more information, visit[Travelers.com/UploadandGo](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.Travelers.com%2Fuploadandgo&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=Travelers.com%2FUploadandGo&index=2&md5=803bc2205c2a337c1dc0c4a9ae5aea47) .


**About Travelers** The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE:[TRV](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=TRV&index=3&md5=b225899056fe708577a55de6394de61b) ) is a leading provider of property casualty insurance for[auto](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fcar-insurance&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=auto&index=4&md5=a07db5d4d22b32fe91d26c21abc366df) ,[home](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fhome-insurance&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=home&index=5&md5=40e0a4a85c98aae5178466018d8e50c7) and[business](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2Fbusiness-insurance&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=business&index=6&md5=8ce981c2eb51d72a428d1eb593a0eec7) . A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, Travelers has more than 30,000 employees and generated revenues of nearly $49 billion in 2025. For more information, visit[Travelers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.travelers.com%2F&esheet=54629018&newsitemid=20261026035319&lan=en-US&anchor=Travelers.com&index=7&md5=8b0b1b2f71744b2c050b8179b2c6495e) .
